prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1421; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Baytown, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were coming from and where you were headed when the collision happened?

A: I was driving home from work. I was heading through the intersection on a green light, going straight.

Q: What was the traffic signal showing for you as you approached?

A: It was green. I'm sure of that because I had just looked up at it before I entered the intersection.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came from my right side, and I only saw it a split second before it hit my driver's side door.

Q: Was there anything that might have blocked your view, like parked cars or a sign?

A: There was a large delivery truck parked on the corner, so my view to the right was limited until I was almost into the crossing.

Q: After the impact, how did your vehicle move, and did you hit anything else?

A: The car spun partway around and stopped against the curb. I didn't hit anything else.

Q: Were you injured, and if so, where?

A: Yes, my left knee hit the steering column and the dashboard. It's swollen and painful, and I've had trouble bending it and putting weight on it.

Q: Have you received any medical treatment since the collision?

A: I went to the emergency room that same day, and I've been seeing a physical therapist since then.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered everything. I just want my knee taken care of and my car repaired.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
